ask-matt.description: Choose the right skill or sequence of skills when the user is unsure which workflow fits their situation or how to move between phases.
ask-matt.default_prompt: Use $ask-matt to recommend the right skill or workflow for my current situation.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

code-review.description: Review a branch, PR, or work in progress against a fixed commit, branch, tag, or merge-base. Assess repository standards and the originating spec separately.
code-review.default_prompt: Use $code-review to review my changes against the agreed baseline on repository standards and the originating spec.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read capability for tracker-hosted specs.

codebase-design.description: Design deep modules with small interfaces and clear seams. Use when shaping a module, exploring alternative interfaces, improving testability or AI navigation, or when another skill needs the shared design vocabulary.
codebase-design.default_prompt: Use $codebase-design to help shape a deep module with a small interface and a clear test seam.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

diagnosing-bugs.description: Diagnose an observed bug, failure, flake, or performance regression. Build a reproducible feedback loop, minimise the failure, test hypotheses, and fix it with a regression test at a suitable seam.
diagnosing-bugs.default_prompt: Use $diagnosing-bugs to reproduce and diagnose the failure I describe, then verify the fix with a suitable regression test.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

domain-modeling.description: Sharpen domain terminology and record resolved terms in a glossary and qualifying decisions in ADRs. Use when changing the domain model, editing GLOSSARY.md, or recording architectural trade-offs; reading existing vocabulary alone does not need this workflow.
domain-modeling.default_prompt: Use $domain-modeling to sharpen the domain terms we are discussing and record resolved terms and qualifying decisions.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

grill-me.description: Sharpen a plan, design, or idea through a plain interview using the shared grilling engine. Use for an interview without glossary or ADR recording; grill-with-docs adds that documentation.
grill-me.default_prompt: Use $grill-me to stress-test my idea, asking one question at a time until we reach a shared understanding.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

grill-with-docs.description: Sharpen a plan or design through an interview while recording resolved domain terms and qualifying decisions in a glossary and ADRs. Use when the discussion should leave project documentation.
grill-with-docs.default_prompt: Use $grill-with-docs to sharpen my plan one question at a time and record resolved terms and qualifying decisions in the project docs.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

grilling.description: Stress-test a plan, decision, or idea through a decision-tree interview until every branch is resolved. Use directly for an interview or as the shared interview engine within another workflow.
grilling.default_prompt: Use $grilling to challenge my plan one question at a time until we agree on the decisions and assumptions.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

handoff.description: Write a portable continuation brief for a fresh agent or colleague, saved outside the workspace. Use when moving to another harness or directory, handing off work, or forking a side task that needs the current context.
handoff.default_prompt: Use $handoff to write a continuation brief for the next session, referencing existing artifacts and suggesting relevant skills.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

implement.description: Implement one approved piece of work from a spec or ticket, with tests at agreed seams, review, and a commit on the current branch. Use for a bounded implementation task; implement-spec coordinates a whole ticket graph.
implement.default_prompt: Use $implement to complete the approved work in the supplied spec or ticket, verify it, and commit on the current branch.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read capability for tracker-hosted tasks.

implement-spec.description: Coordinate implementation of an approved spec and its dependency-linked ticket graph on an integration branch. Use for the whole spec rather than one ticket, following the project's controller and worker constraints.
implement-spec.default_prompt: Use $implement-spec to coordinate the approved spec's ticket graph through implementation and review under this project's controller and worker constraints.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read/write capability for authorized spec and ticket orchestration.

improve-codebase-architecture.description: Survey a codebase for architectural friction and deepening opportunities, present a visual HTML report, then interview the user about their chosen candidate. Use to find refactor candidates before designing or implementing one.
improve-codebase-architecture.default_prompt: Use $improve-codebase-architecture to find worthwhile deepening opportunities and present a visual report so I can choose one to explore.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

pr.description: Write a concise PR body with a visual summary, before/after evidence, and merge risk. Use when drafting or updating a pull request description.
pr.default_prompt: Use $pr to draft a concise PR body showing the change, verification evidence, and merge risk.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

prototype.description: Explore a design question with a throwaway prototype: a shareable HTML demo for logic or state, or contrasting UI variants for appearance. Use when a runnable artifact will help settle the design before production implementation.
prototype.default_prompt: Use $prototype to build a throwaway artifact that answers the design question we are exploring.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub write capability when recording prototype evidence on the tracker.

research.description: Investigate a question against primary sources and save cited findings as a Markdown file in the repo. Use when a decision needs documentation, API facts, or reading legwork, including research delegated to a background agent.
research.default_prompt: Use $research to investigate my question against primary sources and save cited findings in the repository.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

retro.description: Review a completed or troubled coding session and propose improvements to the agent's environment and process: navigation, checks, standards, steering docs, tools, and information access. Use for a session retrospective.
retro.default_prompt: Use $retro to review this session and recommend improvements to the agent environment and process for future work.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

setup-matt-pocock-skills.description: Configure missing or intentionally changed project conventions for Matt skills: issue tracker, triage labels, and domain doc layout. Inspect existing configuration, then confirm proposed changes; use for initial setup or a deliberate convention change.
setup-matt-pocock-skills.default_prompt: Use $setup-matt-pocock-skills to inspect the project conventions and propose any missing or requested configuration changes for confirmation.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read/write capability when configuring the tracker.

tdd.description: Build a feature or fix a bug test-first through red-green slices at agreed public test seams. Use for test-driven implementation, red-green-refactor requests, or integration tests; agree the seams before writing tests.
tdd.default_prompt: Use $tdd to build the agreed behavior one red-green slice at a time through our agreed public test seams.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

teach.description: Teach a requested topic or skill over multiple sessions in a learning workspace with a mission, resources, interactive lessons, and learning records. Use when the user wants a sustained learning workspace rather than an ordinary question answered.
teach.default_prompt: Use $teach to establish a learning workspace for the topic I want to study and guide me through a focused first lesson.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

to-questionnaire.description: Write a Markdown questionnaire when a decision depends on knowledge held by someone else. Interview the user about the recipient and the answers needed, then target the questions at that knowledge gap.
to-questionnaire.default_prompt: Use $to-questionnaire to clarify the recipient and what I need back one question at a time, then write a questionnaire for them.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

to-spec.description: Synthesise already-discussed decisions and codebase context into a spec for the configured issue tracker. Use after discovery has settled the work; confirm test seams without restarting the discovery interview.
to-spec.default_prompt: Use $to-spec to synthesise our agreed discussion into a spec for the configured tracker, confirming test seams without restarting discovery.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read/write capability for authorized spec publication.

to-tickets.description: Break an agreed plan, spec, or conversation into verifiable vertical tickets with explicit blockers. Use when work needs a ticket breakdown; get approval of the slices and dependencies before publishing to the configured tracker.
to-tickets.default_prompt: Use $to-tickets to propose vertical tickets and blocking relationships for our agreed work, then publish the approved breakdown to the configured tracker.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read/write capability for authorized tickets and dependency links.

triage.description: Evaluate incoming issues, verify their claims, and move them through configured triage roles with durable briefs. Use for raw reports or backlog triage; include external PRs only when the tracker treats them as a request surface, or a PR is explicitly named.
triage.default_prompt: Use $triage to show incoming work that needs attention and help me choose an item to evaluate.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read/write capability for authorized issue triage.

wait-what.description: Re-explain the previous response when the user is confused or asks for a simpler explanation. Restore missing context in simplified English using the project's glossary vocabulary.
wait-what.default_prompt: Use $wait-what to explain your last response more simply, with the context I need to follow it.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

wayfinder.description: Map a large, uncertain effort that spans sessions as linked decision tickets on the issue tracker. Use when the route to the destination is unclear; resolve decisions until the work is ready for a spec and implementation tickets.
wayfinder.default_prompt: Use $wayfinder to chart a shared decision map for this large uncertain effort, asking one question at a time to clarify the destination and frontier.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning. GitHub read/write capability for authorized decision maps and tickets.

wizard.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard for setup, credentials, dashboard actions, migrations, or cutovers that require human steps. Use when the human must perform part of the procedure; scope the stages and captured values before authoring the script.
wizard.default_prompt: Use $wizard to scope the human-only steps in this procedure and generate an interactive bash script to guide me through them.

tools.description: BO native GBrain recall before planning.

writing-for-agents.description: Write or improve documents that agents consume: skills, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and referenced instructions. Use when editing those documents or their context pointers to make triggers, steps, and completion criteria predictable.
writing-for-agents.default_prompt: Use $writing-for-agents to improve these agent instructions with clear context pointers, steps, and completion criteria.
